description: The Oppo Find N7 is expected in Q1 2027, possibly March, like its predecessor, the Find N6. While Oppo hasn't revealed anything about the Find N7, reliable tipster Digital Chat Station has shared some details. DCS says that the Oppo Find N7 will be powered by a 2nm chipset and feature a 7.6" screen with a seamless hinge solution. In comparison, the Find N6's cover display measured 6.62" while the folding display measured 8.12". description: Infinix launched the GT 50 Pro back in April, but for some reason it still hasn't made the device available in India. That will thankfully change very soon. Following a brief teaser campaign, today the company has officially revealed the phone's launch date in India: October 27. Unfortunately, pricing for the device will probably only be revealed on that day. While you wait, you can check out our comprehensive in-depth review of the Infinix GT 50 Pro here. description: The Oppo Find X10 series is going global on October 21, and we've already brought you guys a quick first look and unboxing of both the Find X10 and the Find X10 Pro Max. title: OnePlus plans on launching two flagships in India, here's when
description: OnePlus is unveiling the OnePlus 16 in China on October 12, and the Ace 7 may join it or launch soon afterwards. Today a tipster over on X has revealed that the company is planning to launch two new flagship smartphones in India, either in December or in "early 2027". One of them will be the OnePlus 16R, which, if history repeats itself, will be heavily based on the Ace 7, if not a full rebrand of it. description: Nothing's CMF sub-brand is on its way to becoming an independent Indian company, but that transition hasn't stopped it from churning out new products. description: At the beginning of September, the HMD Pulse 2 Pro got prematurely listed by a Swiss retailer, and that revealed its specs. description: An APK teardown of the latest version of Gmail revealed that Google is looking to bring HDR emoji to its Chat app. That’s the Google Hangouts successor, which is part of the Google Workspace suite, for those outside the loop on Google software. A specific code string in the newest Gmail build hints at “display-supported emoji in high dynamic range (HDR) with enhanced brightness and contrast”. title: SpaceX buys spectrum for Starlink to become a full-fledged US mobile carrier
description: Elon Musk’s SpaceX has just acquired up to 14MHz of paired spectrum in the 800MHz band nationwide in the US, from Grain Management. Musk says this is "the last critical piece of the spectrum puzzle needed for SpaceX to provide complete phone coverage in America". So the aim here is clear. Use Starlink satellites to provide mobile phone coverage outdoors, and this 800MHz spectrum to provide indoor coverage. Most existing smartphones already support this band. description: RedMagic’s upcoming flagship, the 12 Pro+, is set to launch in China next week. After revealing the phone’s design and color options recently, the brand has now shared details about the device’s cooling system. title: Computer market shipments fell 20% between July and September
description: According to the latest data from IDC, global computer shipments fell 20.1% in the third quarter of the year (July-September) compared to the same period last year, reaching 62.7 million units. This is the second consecutive quarter of decline, following a much smaller drop of 3.8% in Q2. Shipments in Q3 also fell by 9.1% compared to the previous quarter, so it's anything but a great situation for the industry. There are some things to keep in mind, though. description: Xiaomi has already confirmed that the 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max will be launched internationally, unlike their predecessors from last year. And so with the 18 Ultra rumored to have been canceled, the 18 Pro Max will essentially be the company's flagship smartphone going into 2027. Now, its global version has been spotted in the online results database of Geekbench AI. It has the model number 2611FPNFAG. description: Oppo officially confirmed the ColorOS 17 global launch for October 13 next week, and OnePlus just opened up registrations for OnePlus users to get an early taste of the software. description: The OnePlus 16 is going official next week and ahead of the big unveiling, the brand revealed more key info for the upcoming flagship. The phone will be equipped with a BOE X4 LTPO OLED display. The panel is set to bring 1.5K resolution and up to 185Hz refresh rate, though the max 185Hz will only be available in gaming mode. title: Report: Apple cuts iPhone 18 Pro series component orders amid weak demand
description: According to a new report, Apple has asked some of its suppliers to reduce production of components for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. The report, citing people familiar with the matter, claims that Apple cut component orders by up to 15% for October. The reduction is reportedly driven by weaker market demand amid soaring memory prices. Meanwhile, the report also notes that demand for the new iPhones has been weaker than for last year’s models.
